BEFORE WE TALK

A few straight answers.

Who is TaxiFlow Pro for?+

South African minibus taxi operators and the teams handling their daily finances and fleet records: owners, managers, administrators and drivers.

Can passengers book a ride?+

TaxiFlow Pro manages the taxi business’s operations. It does not offer passenger bookings, ride matching, dispatch or live driver tracking.

Can the team use it on a phone?+

The operational product is a mobile-first web app designed to be installed as a PWA. Device and connectivity checks should form part of a guided rollout, especially on entry-level Android phones.

How much does it cost?+

Pricing is not finalised on this prototype. Start with your fleet, team and workflow needs, then confirm the implementation scope, training, support and recurring costs in a written proposal.
